description: This file defines a Filter class for parsing and matching test case filters based on various tokens such as project, status, labels, annotations, and text. It includes methods for parsing filter expressions, tokenizing input, and matching test case summaries against the filter criteria.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for creating, parsing, and applying filters to test case summaries based on tokens like project, status, labels, annotations, and text.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the filter has no criteria set.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a filter expression string into a Filter object with tokens.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a given test case summary matches the filter criteria.
